    '''

user_prompt:
method split_words(txt: string) returns (result: seq<string>)
    requires txt != null
    ensures (forall i: int :: 0 <= i < |result| ==> result[i] != null) // All words in the result are non-null
    ensures (|result| > 0 ==> forall i: int :: 0 <= i < |result| ==> result[i] != "") // No empty strings in result if not empty
    ensures (|result| == 0 ==> CountLowerCaseOdd(txt) == 0) // If no words returned, count of lowercase letters with odd order is 0
    ensures (|result| > 0 ==> (exists sep: char :: sep == ' ' || sep == ',' ==> 
              (forall i: int :: 0 <= i < |result| ==> result[i] in SplitOnSeparator(txt, sep)))) // Words are split correctly on whitespace or comma
    ensures (|result| == 0 ==> CountLowerCaseOdd(txt) == CountLowerCaseOddWithOddOrder(txt)) // Returns count of odd lowercase letters if no words
    
method CountLowerCaseOdd(txt: string) returns (count: int)
    ensures count >= 0 // Count is non-negative
    ensures count == CountLowerCaseOddWithOddOrder(txt) // Returns the count of lowercase letters in odd positions in the alphabet

method CountLowerCaseOddWithOddOrder(txt: string) returns (count: int)
    ensures count >= 0 // Count is non-negative
    ensures (forall c: char :: 'a' <= c <= 'z' ==> (c in txt ==> (ord(c) % 2 == 1 ==> count > 0))) // Count only considers lowercase letters in odd positions

problem_data.test:
def check(candidate):

    assert candidate("Hello world!") == ["Hello","world!"]
